title: Roasted Ethiopian Vegetarian Kitfo
description: A flavorful and spicy Ethiopian-inspired dish made with roasted kitfo, perfect for a meatless dinner.

ingredients.name: Roasted vegetables (such as carrots, zucchini, bell peppers)
ingredients.notes: Roast in oven at 425°F (220°C) for 20-25 minutes

instructions: Roast the kitfo in the oven for 20-25 minutes, flipping occasionally.
While the kitfo is roasting, heat the niter kibbeh in a pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic to the pan and cook until softened.
Add the berbere spice mix and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the roasted vegetables and chopped tomatoes to the pan and stir to combine.
Once the kitfo is done roasting, fluff it with a fork and add it to the pan.
Stir in the red wine vinegar and olive oil.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
